PullRequest.Title: Add HydraFusion SDK telemetry classifications
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

Related: microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog#8904

## Telemetry ownership

### Exact forwarded HydraFusion events

| Runtime event | VS Code Kusto event |
|---|---|
| `hydrafusion_route` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/hydrafusion_route` |
| `hydrafusion_route_failed` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/hydrafusion_route_failed` |
| `hydrafusion_phase` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/hydrafusion_phase` |
| `hydrafusion_turn` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/hydrafusion_turn` |

### Use native Agent Host events instead

| CLI/runtime event | VS Code Kusto event | Fidelity |
|---|---|---|
| `session_start` | `monacoworkbench/agenthost.requesttokenusage` using `Properties.selectedmodel` | Approximate: only sessions that issued a request |
| `session_model_change` | Successive `agenthost.requesttokenusage` rows using `Properties.selectedmodel` | Approximate: observed at request time |
| `user_message` | `monacoworkbench/agenthost.usermessagesent` | Strong equivalent |
| `assistant_usage` | `monacoworkbench/agenthost.requesttokenusage` | Strong for request-level tokens |
| `assistant_usage` cost | `monacoworkbench/agenthost.turncompleted` using `Measures.billednanoaiu` | Turn-level equivalent |
| `assistant_turn_end` | `monacoworkbench/agenthost.turncompleted` | Strong equivalent |
| `session_idle` with abort | `agenthost.turncompleted` where `Properties.result == "cancelled"` | Approximate |
| `loop_detected` | `monacoworkbench/agenthost.turnhung` | Health proxy, not exact loop detection |

### Existing intentional forwarding

| Runtime event | VS Code Kusto event | Why retained |
|---|---|---|
| `response.success` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/response.success` | Exact model-call, network, and correlation details |
| `response.error` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/response.error` | Exact model-call failure details |
| `tool_call_executed` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/tool_call_executed` | Runtime tool outcome, safe arguments, result size, and token counts |
| `task_complete_todo_state` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/task_complete_todo_state` | No equivalent native todo-state event |
| `model_call_cancelled` | `monacoworkbench/copilotsdk/model_call_cancelled` | No equivalent native cancellation event |

Native Agent Host queries should currently filter with:

```kusto
| where tostring(Properties.provider) == "copilotcli"
```

Forwarded HydraFusion queries should select the standard copy:

```kusto
| where coalesce(tolong(Measures.restricted), 0) == 0
```

Scenarios.Scenario: A HydraFusion agent turn emits route, constituent phase, route-failure when applicable, and aggregate turn telemetry through the Copilot SDK callback.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The SDK callback invokes _routeGitHubTelemetry; non-target HydraFusion kinds reach _forwardGitHubTelemetry and CopilotGitHubTelemetryForwarder.forward, which synchronously copies the bounded event fields and calls publicLog. Telemetry delivery is fire-and-forget and does not gate routing, phase execution, or turn completion. The diff adds only GDPR comment declarations and test calls, so this critical path is byte-for-byte unchanged.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: TelemetryAppenderClient may enqueue one channel.call('log', event data) for each forwarded telemetry event when the agent-host telemetry service is configured with an IPC appender.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: For a HydraFusion turn, one route event plus one event per executed constituent phase plus one aggregate turn event; a route-failure event replaces/adds failure-path telemetry according to runtime emission. No grouping or coalescing occurs in this path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The generic forwarder already accepted every non-target event kind and invoked publicLog with the same payload and event name before this diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The call is not awaited by the forwarding callback, so IPC completion is off the agent-turn critical path; local object preparation remains synchronous and bounded by each small telemetry payload.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: The existing 1DS telemetry appender validates and queues the event for telemetry upload.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one appender log per configured appender for each emitted HydraFusion telemetry notification; phase-event count scales with the number of phases in a turn.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same publicLog call and appender path handled these arbitrary copilotSdk/<kind> events before the added classifications.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: track is invoked through the existing telemetry appender and upload is asynchronous/off the model-turn critical path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The effective event count is O(number of HydraFusion phases per turn), plus constant route and turn events and an occasional failure event. The PR does not change phase count, event emission, payload construction, or forwarding frequency.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The SDK callback starts routing without awaiting it. Non-target standard HydraFusion events perform no asynchronous lookup before forwarding; appender IPC/network work is fire-and-forget. This scheduling and concurrency are unchanged by the diff.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: TelemetryService may buffer events until experiment properties are available with an existing fixed maximum, and the 1DS appender lazily creates and reuses its client. The diff changes no cache keys, warm/cold behavior, coalescing, negative caching, or buffer bounds.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the production hunk consists entirely of block comments, and the traced generic forwarder and telemetry appenders are unchanged. The added test only demonstrates already-existing forwarding behavior.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Backend handling of newly documented schemas is outside the supplied code, but there is no changed executable mechanism in this repository that increases local CPU, memory, IPC, or network work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The declarations add classification metadata but do not activate a new runtime branch, boundary call, allocation path, or higher event cardinality.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the full two-file diff. The only production additions are GDPR classification comments; the test adds four bounded in-memory forwards. Tracing the SDK callback through the generic forwarder and telemetry appenders shows no executable before/after change, no new expensive boundary, and no altered scaling or concurrency, so no findings were submitted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
